phase: Prism colour conversion on import pushed; claim = 3a496bb (on top of SMB-CONVERT-TIFF 8398c7a)

commits.subject: harness (SMB-CONVERT-COLOUR): embedded ICC profiles convert through Prism into the working space on import

capabilities_done: edge harness -> hsk-studio-prism (optional; enabled by import-psd, import-raw and import-tiff): new module src/import/colour.rs builds interop-psd's PrismConverter (Prism::new(default_actor, 4), PrismRoute with SCPF/SDOC ids from reserved SourceMint counters, a counting SinkPort) and every importer passes it to to_proposal / raster_proposal; colour math stays in interop-psd + prism (CX-CAP-001), the harness adds none

working colour space = linear-light sRGB: destination profile src/import/profiles/sRGB-linear-v4.icc (480 B, sha256 4813c25a76abcf572f146c5a36b56ed83526c82327ee9f863553bf1e99c8b64d, CC0 derivative copied unchanged from prism tests/profiles, README + CC0-LICENSE beside it)

PSD (resource 1039) and TIFF (tag 34675) embedded profiles convert through Prism's wide path (configured/assumed intent and BPC reach Prism); camera raw output is already linear sRGB primaries from develop's camera solution (no ICC transform; DNG embedded profiles not read, recorded)

missing profile -> typed profile_assumed_srgb; refused/unparseable profile -> loss entry on document/profile with Prism's code (import still maps under the recorded assumption); CMYK without profile -> typed unmapped layer + cmyk_profile_missing; nothing silent

receipt key colour: status (converted|assumed|not_applied|unmapped_or_not_applicable), route, working + embedded profile sha256, icc_converted, assumed_profile, Prism frame count, interop-psd's conversion report (source space, intent, BPC requested/applied/rule, clip, absolute, engine name/version/simd/fma) and the profile-related loss entries; original profile bytes stay in the import's original entry
RECEIPT_NOT_PROVEN: colour_managed_import replaced by colour_oracle_parity; DESCRIPTOR/manual updated; quiet-source scan covers src/import/colour.rs

tests.argv: cargo nextest run -p hsk-studio-harness --features import-psd,import-raw,import-tiff --test import_colour --test import_psd --no-fail-fast --run-ignored all -E 'binary(import_colour) | test(psd_converts_to_a_native_package_that_opens_in_a_session_with_receipt_and_original) | test(dng_converts_to_one_developed_raster_layer_and_opens_in_a_session)'

PSD and DNG (ignored corpus test, run) routes still green with the converter. Regression: import_tiff (2) + quiet sources also green at 3a496bb.
